questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "ADAMANT"
questions.explanation: ADAMANT का अर्थ होता है अटल, अडिग या हठी। Synonym: Stubborn, Inflexible, Unyielding, Rigid.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "ADAMANT"
questions.explanation: ADAMANT (अडिग/हठी) का Antonym है Flexible (लचीला) या Yielding (नम्र).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "ALACRITY"
questions.explanation: ALACRITY का अर्थ होता है तत्परता, उत्सुकता या फुर्ती। Synonym: Eagerness, Readiness, Promptness.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "ALACRITY"
questions.explanation: ALACRITY (तत्परता) का Antonym है Apathy (उदासीनता) या Reluctance (अनिच्छा).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "BENIGN"
questions.explanation: BENIGN का अर्थ होता है सौम्य, दयालु या अहानिकर। Synonym: Gentle, Kind, Harmless, Favorable.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "BENIGN"
questions.explanation: BENIGN (सौम्य/अहानिकर) का Antonym है Malignant (घातक/हानिकारक) या Hostile.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "CAPRICIOUS"
questions.explanation: CAPRICIOUS का अर्थ होता है सनकी, चंचल या परिवर्तनशील। Synonym: Fickle, Whimsical, Unpredictable.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "CAPRICIOUS"
questions.explanation: CAPRICIOUS (परिवर्तनशील/सनकी) का Antonym है Stable (स्थिर) या Constant.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A place where animals are slaughtered for human consumption/food"
questions.explanation: पशुवधशाला जहाँ पशु काटे जाते हैं उसे Abattoir कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who devotes his life to the unselfish welfare and service of others"
questions.explanation: परोपकारी व्यक्ति को Altruist या Philanthropist कहते हैं (Misanthrope = मानवद्वेषी)।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who is incapable of making mistakes or committing errors"
questions.explanation: जिससे कभी गलती न हो उसे Infallible (अचूक/अचूक व्यक्ति) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "That which is impossible to be conquered, defeated or overcome"
questions.explanation: जिसे जीता या पराजित न किया जा सके उसे Invincible (अजेय) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "One who is beyond reform or impossible to be corrected"
questions.explanation: जिसे सुधारा न जा सके उसे Incorrigible (असुधार्य) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Actions speak louder than words"
options: What someone actually does has more impact than what they merely say
To shout loudly to make an impression
Words are more important than deeds
questions.explanation: Actions speak louder than words = कथनी से करनी भारी, काम बोलता है।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "At the end of one's tether"
options: Having no more patience, energy or endurance left
At the end of a long rope
questions.explanation: At the end of one's tether = सहनशक्ति की अंतिम सीमा पर होना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Beat a dead horse"
options: Waste effort on a futile task that cannot be changed
questions.explanation: Beat a dead horse = गड़े मुर्दे उखाड़ना या व्यर्थ का प्रयास करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Best of both worlds"
options: All the advantages and benefits of two different situations at once
A choice between good and evil
questions.explanation: Best of both worlds = दोनों हाथों में लड्डू होना, दोनों परिस्थितियों का लाभ उठाना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Bite off more than you can chew"
options: To eat too much at once
Take on a responsibility or task that is beyond one's capacity
questions.explanation: Bite off more than you can chew = औकात/क्षमता से अधिक काम अपने सिर लेना।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "He has been living in Delhi since five years."
questions.explanation: Rule: निश्चित समय (Point of time) के साथ 'since' तथा अनिश्चित अवधि (Period of time) के साथ 'for' आता है (for five years).

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "Unless you do not tell the truth, I will punish you."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Unless' स्वयं नकारात्मक है, इसके साथ 'do not' हटाकर 'Unless you tell' प्रयुक्त होगा।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "The furniture in his room are very old."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Furniture' अनकाउंटेबल सिंगुलर नाउन है, अतः प्लुरल वर्ब 'are' की जगह 'is' आएगा।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He is addicted _____ gambling and alcohol."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Addicted to' (किसी लत/बुरी आदत का शिकार होना) के साथ preposition 'to' + V-ing/noun आता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "Beware _____ stray dogs at night."
questions.explanation: Rule: Adjective/Verb 'Beware' के साथ हमेशा preposition 'of' का प्रयोग होता है (Beware of dogs).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She complies _____ all the college regulations."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Comply' के साथ हमेशा 'with' आता है (Comply with rules/regulations).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "METICULOUS"
questions.explanation: METICULOUS का अर्थ होता है सूक्ष्म, अतिसावधान या सतर्क। Synonym: Careful, Fastidious, Precise.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "METICULOUS"
questions.explanation: METICULOUS (सावधान) का Antonym है Careless (लापरवाह) या Negligent.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "TRANSIENT"
questions.explanation: TRANSIENT का अर्थ होता है क्षणिक या अस्थाई। Synonym: Ephemeral, Temporary, Fleeting.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "TRANSIENT"
questions.explanation: TRANSIENT (अस्थाई) का Antonym है Permanent (स्थाई) या Perpetual.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "One who deserts and abandons his religious or political faith"
questions.explanation: अपने धर्म या राजनीतिक विश्वास को त्यागने वाले स्वधर्मत्यागी को Apostate कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person or animal that eats human flesh"
questions.explanation: नरभक्षी (अपनी ही प्रजाति/इंसान का मांस खाने वाले) को Cannibal कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who compiles or writes dictionaries"
questions.explanation: शब्दकोश (Dictionary) संकलित करने वाले व्यक्ति को Lexicographer कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who draws, designs or produces geographical maps"
questions.explanation: मानचित्र (Maps) बनाने वाले मानचित्रकार को Cartographer कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Cross that bridge when you come to it"
options: To build a bridge over a river
Deal with a problem only when it actually occurs, not beforehand
questions.explanation: Cross that bridge when you come to it = जब मुसीबत आएगी तब उससे निपटेंगे, पहले से चिंता न करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Every cloud has a silver lining"
options: A bad event leads to worse consequences
Every difficult or sad situation has a hopeful/positive side
questions.explanation: Every cloud has a silver lining = निराशा में भी आशा की किरण छिपी होती है।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Get out of hand"
options: To lose a ring from finger
questions.explanation: Get out of hand = हाथ से निकल जाना, नियंत्रण से बाहर हो जाना।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "I <u>am working</u> in this company for ten years."
questions.explanation: Rule: समय की अवधि ('for ten years') के साथ घटना वर्तमान तक जारी होने पर Present Perfect Continuous (have been working) आएगा।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "Scarcely had the bell rung <u>than</u> the students rushed out."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Scarcely' के साथ कंजंक्शन सदैव 'when' आता है (Scarcely had... when...).

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "They have built a new bridge."
options: A new bridge is built by them.
A new bridge had been built by them.
A new bridge was built by them.
A new bridge has been built by them.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect (have + V3) का Passive = Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "She sings a beautiful song."
options: A beautiful song is sung by her.
A beautiful song has been sung by her.
A beautiful song was sung by her.
A beautiful song is being sung by her.
questions.explanation: Present Simple (V1) का Passive = Object + is/am/are + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said, "I am reading a book."
options: He asked if he was reading a book.
He said that he was reading a book.
He told that he is reading a book.
He said that I am reading a book.
questions.explanation: Reporting verb Past Tense में होने से Present Continuous (am reading) बदलकर Past Continuous (was reading) बनेगा।

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: She said to her brother, "Where are you going?"
options: She asked her brother that where he was going.
She asked her brother where he was going.
She asked her brother where was he going.
She told her brother where you are going.
questions.explanation: Interrogative WH- sentence का Indirect = asked + her brother + where + he (Subject) + was going.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "REPUBLIC"
questions.explanation: REPUBLIC का अर्थ होता है गणतंत्र या प्रजातंत्र जहाँ शासन का प्रमुख निर्वाचित होता है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "AUTOCRACY"
questions.explanation: AUTOCRACY (निरंकुश एकतंत्र) का Antonym है Democracy (लोकतंत्र/प्रजातन्त्र) या Republic.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "An underground room or vault used for storing grain, wine or coal"
questions.explanation: जमीन के नीचे अनाज, शराब या कोयला रखने के तहखाने को Cellar कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "An extreme or irrational fear or hatred of foreigners or strangers"
questions.explanation: विदेशियों या अजनबियों से अत्यधिक भय/घृणा को Xenophobia कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Extreme fear of confined or enclosed spaces"
questions.explanation: संकीर्ण/बंद जगहों के डर को Claustrophobia कहते हैं।

questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी HIERARCHY (पदानुक्रम/श्रेणीबद्धता) है।
